text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In preparation to take on the Twinkle Series,
days of serious training with Curren Chan
have begun.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yaaaahhhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan has great sprint aptitude.
When we had her run 1200 meters,
her talent was undeniable—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Bro~ther♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big sis~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
How was Curren?
I tried running as hard as I could~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay~♪
Ehehe, praise me more, praise me!
choice_data_list: I can't wait to see how much you grow!
I'm so excited to see how much you'll grow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we focus on developing her abilities as a sprinter
from now on, she can definitely aim for the top level.
However—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then~, maybe I'll capture
the current Curren as a keepsake to look back on♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother!
Take a picture, take a picture~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big sis!
Take a pic, take a pic-!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Splash)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Could you send that to my phone?
I'm gonna update my Umastagram with it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"'Full-scale training starts now!
#IllDoMyBest #CheerMeOn
#CuteCurrenChan'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She boasts the highest follower count on social media and knows exactly how to pull people into her own pace.
Figuring out how to handle her will likely be key.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! It's Curren!
She's so cute, as always~!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, she's in the middle of training.
It's rude to interrupt.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, I'm okay~.
Thanks for checking in on me♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Hwah?! They replied! B-But wouldn't I be in the way...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine! I've already finished
almost all of today's quota.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Since it was the first day, you just wanted to do basic drills and see my current skill level... right, big brother?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Since it was the first day, you just wanted to do basic drills and see my current skill level... right, big sister?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
See, it's fine, right?
Please, ask me anything♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Waaah... thank you so much!
I-I've been following Curren's Umastagram all this time—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To be honest, I also wanted to have a meeting about our future direction... but seeing that happy young fan, I swallowed my words for the day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, a few days later.
I called Curren Chan over again, telling her
'there's something important we need to discuss,' but..."

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Here's our new item, the 'Mega Fluffy French Toast.'
Thank you for waiting~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes! 
Yep, just as Curren's intuition predicted! 
Super duper cute~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Taking a selfie through a mountain of whipped cream
seemed so Insta-worthy~
It's totally gonna blow up, so I had to jump on it!
choice_data_list: And that's why we're at a family restaurant...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"She said it was an ‘important talk,’
but she didn't say it was a secret,
so I thought it'd be fine~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's not worry about the location for now.
In order to determine our future path,
first, we should align on—"
choice_data_list: I want to hear about Curren's goals

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Of course! "I want to show everyone
just how cute Curren is"♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Goals for the race?
Hmm... None, I guess!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, you're way too startled!
Your eyes are gonna pop out, you know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah, but... there might actually be a title I'm interested in?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—The "Triple Tiara."
It sounds so glamorous and cute...
Don't you think it suits Curren to a tee?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Oka Sho, the Yushun Himba (Japanese Oaks), and the Shuka Sho.
The Triple Tiara—a title bestowed only upon the Umamusume who conquer all three GⅠ races...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While it is a great honor for an Umamusume,
even the shortest race, the Oka Sho, is 1,600 meters.
It will be a grueling path for a sprinter like her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, once I told her that—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
For now, wouldn't it hurt to see
how far we can stretch the distance?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Training has only just begun,
so I think it's too early to decide that this is definitely Curren's direction.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
1,200m went great, so next is 1,400m.
If you clear that, then 1,600m... How about
we stretch the distance little by little like that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As she says, if she gets the results, challenging the Triple Tiara might be a good idea. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"If we're aiming for something, it has to be the top, right?♪
Don't you think so, Big Brother?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"If we're aiming for something, it has to be the top, right?♪
Don't you think so, Big Sister?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If she has a dream she wants to strive for, as her Trainer, I want to support her with everything I've got!
choice_data_list: Got it, let's wait and see for now

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay~♪
Curren will do her best with you, Onii-chan!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yay~♪
Curren will do her best with you, Onee-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan seemed full of motivation.
Seeing that, I was about to hammer out the immediate plans with her, when—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Big Brother♪
Scoot over~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Big Sis♪
Scoot over for me~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snap! Click-click-click!!*)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, Onii-chan, your angle is a bit off, you know?
One more time, this time put your right hand on your cheek—
Yep, super cute~♪ Hold it right there!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, Onee-chan, your angle is a bit off, you know?
One more time, this time put your right hand on your cheek—
Yep, super cute~♪ Hold it right there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“...Already sensing I'd be dragged around every which way,
my days of chasing 'kawaii?' with Curren Chan began!”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
'#MegaFluffyFrenchToast #With
#CuteCurrenChan #With
#Currens #Trainer♪'
